messages.subject: R dashboards with Shiny, D3, and ggplot2
parts:
Hi all,

I thought I'd pass along two new developments relevant to this group. I saw questions about Plotly and Shiny from 1/31/14 by Dawg, and another on Mar 2 by Jonathan. 

First, here's a post that shows how you can make interactive dashboards with R, Shiny, and ggplot2: http://moderndata.plot.ly/dashboards-in-r-with-shiny-plotly/. For more, see our R API: https://plot.ly/r and ggplot2 support: https://plot.ly/ggplot2/.

Your graphs will render with D3.js and allow you to zoom, pan, see data on the hover, and more. For other dashboard applications, you might like this walk-through: http://blog.plot.ly/post/123617968702/online-dashboards-eight-helpful-tips-you-should.

I work for Plotly, and we're still in the early stages of planning and developing our R support, so any and all feedback, thoughts, and suggestions are welcome. Thanks!

M
